mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, nickname, password, email, avatar, description, github_url, bilibili_url, create_time) values (#{username}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{description}, #{githubUrl}, #{bilibiliUrl}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.avatar, u.description, u.github_url, u.bilibili_url, (select count(1) from article a where a.user_id = u.user_id and a.status = 'publish') as articleCount, (select count(1) from tag) as tagCount, (select count(1) from site) as siteCount from `user` u where u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update `user` set nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, avatar = #{avatar}, description = #{description}, github_url = #{githubUrl}, bilibili_url = #{bilibiliUrl}, background = #{background} where user_id = #{userId}
